# cloudblast Provider

The CloudBlast provider manages cloud infrastructure via the CloudBlast REST API v2.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cloudblast = {
      source = "aficiomaquinas/cloudblast"
    }
  }
}

provider "cloudblast" {
  # API token can also be set via CLOUDBLAST_API_TOKEN env var
  # api_token = "cb_live_..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token for authentication. Can also be set via the `CLOUDBLAST_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) API base URL. Defaults to `https://console.cloudblast.io/api/v2`. Can also be set via the `CLOUDBLAST_API_URL` environment variable.
